description: This file defines a base class for media pipeline testing, including mock objects, setup methods, and test utilities for the MediaPipeline component in a media processing system.

classes.name: MediaPipelineTestBase
classes.description: A test fixture class for media pipeline unit tests, providing setup and utility methods, mock objects, and common test variables.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the test fixture.

methods.name: ~MediaPipelineTestBase
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the test fixture.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Initializes the media pipeline object for testing.

methods.name: destroyMediaPipeline
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the media pipeline object.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectations for enqueuing a task on the main thread.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets expectations for enqueuing a task on the main thread and waiting for its completion.

methods.name: loadGstPlayer
methods.description: Loads or initializes the GStreamer player mock.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source of a given type and MIME type to the pipeline.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets the end-of-stream condition for a specified media source type.

methods.name: expectNotifyNeedData
methods.description: Sets expectations for notification of need data for a media source.

methods.name: expectNotifyNeedDataEos
methods.description: Sets expectations for notification of need data at end-of-stream for a media source.
